saw_lines: Buyers rarely switch toothpaste for an ingredient name. They switch when the reason is clear, then reorder without thinking.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides whether the mineral claim earns a second look.

points: Your site shows 678 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so skimmers get no proof to trust. Put the 678 figure on the creative and open two ads with a review quote in the first line.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to commit to a repeat order. Open three new ads with subscribe and save in line one and on the creative.

Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. New buyers who wonder about arrival scroll on. Answer it in line one of ads for new buyers, naming free shipping over $70.

Your site runs a subscribe and save offer, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Repeat buyers never hear the saving that would keep them. Run two retention ads for past buyers with subscribe and save as the headline.
